title: Bass 2004 outer AF biaxial (circumferential strain held at 0, axial stretch), typical specimen - digitised from Ghezelbash 2021 Fig 5b,c

quantity.name: stress-strain curve
quantity.definition: axial and circumferential stress vs axial strain with circumferential Lagrangian strain held at E22 = 0 (Bass Fig 3a,b diamonds), as re-plotted by Ghezelbash 2021 Fig 5b,c ('Bass et al.: One Sample'); x_value = strain as plotted (equal to Bass E11), nominal_strain = sqrt(1+2E) - 1

source.authors: Bass EC, Ashford FA, Segal MR, Lotz JC
source.sample: 5 outer anterior AF cruciform specimens (3 L3-L4, 2 L4-L5), 5 autopsy spines, grade I-II; curve = one typical specimen

protocol.summary: Cruciform bone-AF-bone specimen (AF ~1.57 mm thick); 0.5 N preload; axial deformation at <0.0001 /s (quasi-static) while central E22 held at 0 by a feedback-controlled circumferential motor; strain from 9-pin grid (3.3 x 3.0 mm); stresses are Piola-Kirchhoff (Bass Eq 2), computation from force not stated.
how_to_simulate: Cruciform specimen: w=20, ww=10, h=12, hw=9 mm, thickness 1.5 mm, bony ends rigid (Ghezelbash 2021 Fig 5)
Preload 0.5 N circumferentially, then fix the circumferential grips
Track a 3x3 mm central square for strain; report axial and circumferential nominal stress vs axial nominal strain
protocol.notes: SECONDARY digitisation: Bass Fig 3a,b has six overlapping biaxial runs, so the E22=0 run was taken from Ghezelbash 2021 Fig 5b,c. Cross-check with Bass Fig 3a diamonds: E11=0.10 -> ~0.52 MPa (agrees). Ghezelbash 2021 also plots a +-SD band to 0.1 strain (source not stated) - not extracted. Hidden point near 0.08 axial strain (panel c) omitted.

extraction.from: Ghezelbash et al. 2021 (Acta Biomater submission, SSRN 3677348) Fig 5b,c (PDF p.36); primary Bass 2004 Fig 3a,b
extraction.uncertainty: strain +/-0.002, stress +/-0.02 MPa (low-resolution raster with watermark)
extraction.check_notes: Rendered at 300 dpi; axes calibrated on tick labels (x 0-0.12, y 0-1.0/1.1 MPa) and verified with a grid overlay; blue symbol centroids found by colour segmentation and re-plotted as an overlay: all fall on symbol centres. Two points re-read: panel c (0.099, 0.525), panel b (0.0553, 0.331). n=1 (typical specimen).

pass_rule.rule: model curve within the stated digitising uncertainty band of the measured curve over the tested range
